name: context-core
description: Proactive scoped recall and approval-gated context capture with coordinated writes.

interface.shortDescription: Recall prior context and suggest durable capture safely.
interface.longDescription: Installs a managed conversational workflow for scoped recall, actual-body comparison, conflict notification, and approval-gated capture; stores handoffs and evidence as Markdown and remains the only physical writer for context-common/v2 owners.
defaultPrompt: Audit new meaning only; stay silent without durable signal. Recall metadata-first only when it can change the answer.
Report conflicts or rationale changes before the conclusion; preview complete text and ask once.
Direct, explicit, unconditional yes: pass `approval_digest` unchanged; verify core SHA, repo, CAS, lock; never regenerate.
